decks.notes: The strategy of this deck revolves around using cards like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful combo that can quickly win the game. By efficiently countering opponent's spells and drawing cards to control the game, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a devastating attack. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Counterspell and Chain of Vapor provide additional disruption and protection for the combo. The deck seeks to manipulate the game to its advantage and win through a powerful and efficient combo.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures into play from the graveyard using a combination of reanimation spells and discard outlets. By utilizing cards like Reanimate, Exhume, and Animate Dead, along with creatures like Akroma, Angel of Wrath and Phantom Nishoba, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large threats early in the game. The deck also includes cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to accelerate its game plan and disrupt the opponent with cards like Cabal Therapy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly flood the board with aggressive creatures like Grim Lavamancer, Mogg Fanatic, and Jackal Pup, while using burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate to clear the way for them to attack. The deck also includes cards like Call of the Herd and Sylvan Library to generate additional threats and card advantage. With a mix of creatures, burn spells, and land destruction in the form of Wasteland, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game.

The deck focuses on using Survival of the Fittest to tutor for powerful creatures that can control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. This is achieved by efficiently generating resources with mana production creatures and utilizing cards like Winter Orb and Opposition to further control the board. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by consistently deploying threats and disrupting their game plan through a combination of creature-based control and resource denial.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly pressure the opponent with aggressive creatures like Skyshroud Elite, Wild Mongrel, and Jackal Pup, backed up by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate for direct damage. The inclusion of cards like Grim Lavamancer and Seal of Fire provide additional removal options. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and close out games early with powerful threats like Flametongue Kavu and Call of the Herd, while also utilizing card draw from Sylvan Library to keep up the pressure.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and efficient burn spells. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, this deck aims to deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. The inclusion of cards like Grim Lavamancer and Sulfuric Vortex helps ensure a steady stream of damage while keeping up the pressure on the opponent. By maintaining a fast-paced aggressive strategy, this deck aims to finish off the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this Premodern 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly play a Phyrexian Dreadnought and then use spells like Stifle, Counterspell, and Foil to protect it from being countered or removed. The deck also includes card draw and search spells like Impulse and Portent to find the necessary combo pieces. Additionally, there are disruption spells like Duress to control the opponent's hand and slow down their game plan. Overall, the deck aims to assemble the Stiflenought combo efficiently and protect it to secure a win.

The deck is focused on utilizing creature cards with powerful effects to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By utilizing cards like Sneak Attack, Natural Order, and Survival of the Fittest, the deck aims to bring out powerful creatures like Nicol Bolas, Symbiotic Wurm, and Dragon Tyrant to dominate the battlefield. With a mix of ramp and creature recursion, the deck can adapt to different situations and maintain board control while building a powerful board presence to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of card draw, discard spells, and creature abilities to set up a win condition with Tireless Tribe, in order to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also has some utility spells like Prismatic Strands and Ray of Revelation to deal with opposing threats, as well as protection spells like Swords to Plowshares to keep our creatures safe. The land base is designed to support the deck's mana requirements and ensure consistency in drawing the necessary colors for the combo.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively put pressure on the opponent by playing efficient and low-cost creatures while disrupting their hand with cards like Duress and Cabal Therapy. Rancor and Call of the Herd provide additional staying power and threats on the board, while cards like Smother and Bone Shredder help deal with the opponent's threats. The deck aims to win the game by overwhelming the opponent with a fast and relentless assault, utilizing a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

This BW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate, as well as disruptive cards like Duress and Gerrard's Verdict. The deck also utilizes powerful finishers in the form of Exalted Angel and Decree of Justice, while also providing card advantage through Skeletal Scrying and Eternal Dragon. The mana base is built to support the deck's color requirements and includes utility lands like Dust Bowl. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and win through incremental advantage and powerful threats.

This deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy by using a combination of hand disruption spells and removals like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate. It also looks to generate card advantage with Phyrexian Arena and pressure the opponent with efficient creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Exalted Angel. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy while being able to deal with opposing non-basic lands through cards like Wasteland and Seal of Cleansing.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive Goblin creatures, taking advantage of cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Warchief to quickly flood the board. Cards like Goblin Ringleader and Siege-Gang Commander provide card advantage and additional threats. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Wasteland, while also running some removal with Mogg Fanatic and Naturalize. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure to opponents, aiming to win through brute force and efficient aggression.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements combined with land denial tactics to slow down the opponent's game plan and eventually overpower them with powerful spells and creatures. By efficiently countering threats, removing opponent's permanents, and consistently drawing cards with cards like Fact or Fiction, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence while keeping the opponent at bay. The use of Standstill as a card draw engine and the inclusion of versatile removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God further solidify the deck's control strategy.

This deck focuses on early aggression and consistent damage output. By using low-cost creatures like Grim Lavamancer, Jackal Pup, and Mogg Fanatic, it puts pressure on the opponent from the start. The inclusion of spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate allows for removal of opposing threats. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Naturalize and Wasteland. Sylvan Library helps with card advantage while Call of the Herd provides a steady stream of creatures. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently with a mix of creatures and burn spells.

The deck focuses on using a combination of creatures and spells to control the opponent's actions, while also applying pressure with efficient threats like Lightning Angel and Exalted Angel. Counterspells and removal like Swords to Plowshares and Lightning Bolt help to disrupt the opponent's plans, while cards like Meddling Mage provide targeted disruption. The mana base allows for consistent access to both white and blue mana sources, enabling the deck to cast a variety of spells efficiently and adapt to different matchups.
